records.text: Val Peterson recalled seeing Colombian army trucks take young men to boot camp if they lacked identification proving they had already served, during his LDS mission in Colombia.
records.speaker: Val L. Peterson

appearances.snippet: During the LDS mission in Colombia, where conscripted military service is required of all young men in military, he would watch as Colombian army trucks would roll down the street and literally snatch off kids for boot camp if they didn't have ID proving that they had already served. ... That still sticks out in my mind, Peterson (Val Peterson) said. I used to think of how little they had to defend and in reality how much we had to defend.
